title: John Bowne House

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Come see where the Bowne family lived from their earliest days in 17th-century Flushing. Learn about how they helped cultivate the landscape and establish a community in what was once a densely wooded area. Visit the places in which the family worshipped, the land they worked, and the homes they resided in. Whether you are just visiting the neighborhood for the day or have lived here for years, you will come away with a new appreciation for the long history of Flushing! The Bowne family were among the first European settlers of Flushing, arriving in the 1650s and maintaining the same family home for 9 generations.
